# Staal Real Estate

> Boutique, occupier-side warehouse real estate advisory based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. We represent tenants and buyers only — never landlords — helping international e-commerce, fulfilment, logistics and distribution companies find, lease and acquire warehouse space across the Netherlands.

Founder & advisor: Tex Staal · tex@staalre.com · +31 6 28 36 36 31
Office: Speerstraat 7-2, 1076XM Amsterdam, Netherlands (working nationwide)
Independent and occupier-only: we never act for the landlord.

## Services
- Lease advisory — full market search, shortlisting, viewings, and negotiation of Dutch (ROZ-model) leases on the occupier's side.
- Acquisition support — sourcing, due-diligence support and price negotiation for owner-occupiers.
- Renewals & relocations — renegotiation, expansion, and stay-or-go advice ahead of break dates.
- Market-entry guidance — location strategy and remote viewings for international teams deciding from abroad, in English.

## Dutch warehouse hubs we cover
- Rotterdam & the port corridor — container/deep-sea flows, A15 corridor; premium rents, tight land.
- Venlo & the southeast — German-border, tri-modal (road/rail/barge); often ranked Europe's top logistics location.
- Tilburg–Waalwijk & central Brabant — XXL warehousing and the e-commerce fulfilment cluster.
- Schiphol & the Randstad — air cargo, high-value/time-critical goods; highest rents, smallest units.
- Also: Breda–Moerdijk, Eindhoven (Brainport), Nijmegen–Arnhem, Roermond–Maastricht.

## Insights (full articles)
- [Leasing warehouse space in the Netherlands](https://staalre.com/insights/leasing-warehouse-space-netherlands): Dutch leases use the standardised ROZ model and almost everything is negotiable — break options, CPI-indexation caps (3–4%), service-charge scope, and reinstatement. Incentives (rent-free periods, fit-out contributions) are not public and require representation to access.
- [Rotterdam, Venlo or Tilburg — choosing a Dutch logistics hub](https://staalre.com/insights/dutch-logistics-hub-comparison): Rotterdam for containers, Venlo for the German market, Tilburg–Waalwijk for e-commerce fulfilment, Schiphol for air cargo. Price labour and grid capacity (netcongestie), not just rent.
- [Lease or buy a distribution warehouse](https://staalre.com/insights/lease-or-buy-distribution): Lease for speed, flexibility and capital efficiency; buy for specialised fit-out, scarce locations, or long-horizon sites. Most institutional Dutch stock is leasable, not buyable.
